data.name: Mahlatini: Enquiry → Outlook + Claude + Power BI

parameters.jsCode:
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // NORMALISE PAYLOAD — unify website form + chatbot into // a common schema for downstream Outlook + Claude nodes // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ const body = $input.first().json; const isWebsite = body._source === 'website'; // --- Unified client object --- const client = { name: isWebsite ? body.form_data.name : (body.client?.name || 'Unknown'), email: isWebsite ? body.form_data.email : (body.client?.email || ''), phone: isWebsite ? (body.form_data.phone || '') : (body.client?.phone || ''), lead_score: isWebsite ? null : (body.intelligence?.lead_score || body.client?.lead_score || null), classification: isWebsite ? 'website_form' : (body.intelligence?.classification || body.client?.classification || 'standard'), source_page: isWebsite ? (body.metadata?.page_url || '') : (body.client?.source_page || ''), }; // --- Unified enquiry object --- const enquiry = { destination: isWebsite ? (body.form_data.destination || '') : (body.enquiry?.destination || ''), travel_dates: isWebsite ? (body.form_data.travel_dates || '') : (body.enquiry?.travel_dates?.start || ''), duration: isWebsite ? (body.form_data.duration || '') : (body.enquiry?.duration_days ? body.enquiry.duration_days + ' days' : ''), adults: isWebsite ? (body.form_data.party_size?.adults || '') : (body.enquiry?.pax?.adults || ''), children: isWebsite ? (body.form_data.party_size?.children || 0) : (body.enquiry?.pax?.children || 0), children_ages: isWebsite ? (body.form_data.party_size?.children_ages || []) : [], budget: isWebsite ? (body.form_data.budget_range || '') : ( body.enquiry?.budget_range?.currency && body.enquiry?.budget_range?.max ? body.enquiry.budget_range.currency + ' ' + body.enquiry.budget_range.max : '' ), experience_type: (() => { const raw = isWebsite ? (body.form_data.experience_type || []) : (body.enquiry?.experience_type || []); return Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : (typeof raw === 'string' && raw ? [raw] : []); })(), special_occasion: isWebsite ? (body.form_data.special_occasion || null) : null, message: isWebsite ? (body.form_data.message || '') : (body.conversation_summary || body.enquiry?.special_requests || ''), how_heard: isWebsite ? (body.form_data.how_heard || '') : '', }; // --- Intelligence (chatbot provides this, website gets defaults) --- const intelligence = { primary_intent: isWebsite ? 'website_enquiry' : (body.intelligence?.primary_intent || 'general_enquiry'), booking_stage: isWebsite ? 'considering' : (body.intelligence?.booking_stage || 'browsing'), urgency: isWebsite ? 'medium' : (body.intelligence?.urgency || 'low'), sentiment: isWebsite ? 'neutral' : (body.intelligence?.sentiment || 'neutral'), lead_score: client.lead_score, }; // --- Build HTML email body --- const totalPax = (parseInt(enquiry.adults) || 0) + (parseInt(enquiry.children) || 0); const childrenInfo = enquiry.children > 0 ? enquiry.children + ' children' + (enquiry.children_ages.length ? ' (ages: ' + enquiry.children_ages.join(', ') + ')' : '') : 'None'; const emailHtml = `

New Travel Enquiry — ${client.name}

Source: ${isWebsite ? 'Website Form' : 'AI Chatbot'} | ${new Date().toISOString()}

${enquiry.special_occasion ? '' : ''} ${enquiry.how_heard ? '' : ''}
Name ${client.name}
Email ${client.email}
Phone ${client.phone || 'Not provided'}
Destination ${enquiry.destination || 'Not specified'}
Travel Dates ${enquiry.travel_dates || 'Flexible'}
Duration ${enquiry.duration || 'TBD'}
Party Size ${enquiry.adults || '?'} adults, ${childrenInfo}
Budget ${enquiry.budget || 'Not specified'}
Experience ${(Array.isArray(enquiry.experience_type) ? enquiry.experience_type.join(', ') : (enquiry.experience_type || '')) || 'Not specified'}
Special Occasion' + enquiry.special_occasion + '
How Heard' + enquiry.how_heard + '
Message:
${enquiry.message || 'No additional message'}
Lead Score: ${intelligence.lead_score || 'N/A'} | Stage: ${intelligence.booking_stage} | Urgency: ${intelligence.urgency} | Sentiment: ${intelligence.sentiment} | Source: ${client.source_page || 'Direct'}
`; // --- Email subject --- const subjectTag = intelligence.urgency === 'high' || intelligence.urgency === 'critical' ? 'URGENT' : 'NEW'; const emailSubject = `[${subjectTag}] Enquiry: ${client.name} — ${enquiry.destination || 'General'}`; return [{ json: { _source: body._source, client, enquiry, intelligence, emailSubject, emailHtml, timestamp: body.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(), raw: body, } }];

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.CLAUDE_MODEL || "claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929", max_tokens: 200, temperature: 0.1, messages: [{ role: "user", content: "You are an email priority classifier for Mahlatini, a luxury African safari and travel company.

Classify the following customer enquiry into exactly ONE priority level.

Rules:
- IMMEDIATE: Travel within 30 days, OR explicitly says urgent/ASAP, OR lead_score >= 80, OR booking_stage is ready_to_book, OR mentions complaint/problem with existing booking, OR urgency is high/critical
- IMPORTANT: Travel within 90 days, OR lead_score >= 50, OR budget > £10000, OR booking_stage is considering, OR group size >= 6, OR special_occasion is set
- NOT_IMPORTANT: General browsing, no dates, low budget signals, newsletter signups, blog-related questions, lead_score < 30

Respond with ONLY valid JSON, no markdown:
{"classification": "IMMEDIATE|IMPORTANT|NOT_IMPORTANT", "reason": "one sentence explanation", "confidence": 0.0-1.0}

---
ENQUIRY:
Name: " + $json.client.name + "
Destination: " + ($json.enquiry.destination || "Not specified") + "
Travel Dates: " + ($json.enquiry.travel_dates || "Not specified") + "
Budget: " + ($json.enquiry.budget || "Not specified") + "
Party Size: " + (($json.enquiry.adults || 0) + ($json.enquiry.children || 0)) + " people
Lead Score: " + ($json.intelligence.lead_score || "N/A") + "
Booking Stage: " + ($json.intelligence.booking_stage || "unknown") + "
Urgency: " + ($json.intelligence.urgency || "unknown") + "
Special Occasion: " + ($json.enquiry.special_occasion || "None") + "
Message: " + ($json.enquiry.message || "No message").substring(0, 1000) }] }) }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO analytics_events (event_type, payload, created_at)
VALUES (
  'enquiry_classified',
  $1::jsonb,
  NOW()
)

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: "ok", classification: $("Build Outlook Patch").first().json.classification || "UNKNOWN", reason: $("Build Outlook Patch").first().json.classificationReason || "", confidence: $("Build Outlook Patch").first().json.classificationConfidence || 0, outlook_message_id: $("Capture Message ID").first().json.outlookMessageId || "" }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ subject: $json.emailSubject, body: { contentType: 'HTML', content: $json.emailHtml }, toRecipients: [{ emailAddress: { address: $env.OUTLOOK_MAILBOX || 'mark@thevortextrader.com' } }], importance: 'normal' }) }}
